instruction: Triage this batch of customer support emails: assign each email to exactly one support category by its primary intent.

emails.subject: Contractor can't get in
emails.body: our new contractor — well, contractor-to-be — says the portal doesn't work, but it works for the rest of us, so i mean it's not down, they just never got added; pls give viewer access to the Atlas project

emails.subject: Double charge among praise
emails.body: love the tool, anyway — small thing, the webhook docs are thin, for later — the thing i need now, sorry: our last invoice has two identical line items, we got double-charged, refund one pls

emails.subject: Sync failing, not the address
emails.body: thanks for the address fix last week; separate thing, that charge question is resolved on our side — the actual live issue: nightly data sync via your API has timed out for 3 nights, reports are stale, pls look

emails.subject: Access after role change
emails.body: after you changed my role, or updated it i guess, i can't reach billing anymore — colleagues can, so not an outage — just restore my perms

emails.subject: Still charged for removed seats
emails.body: we removed seats last month, that part's done, but the invoice, this one, still charges the old count — fix the charge pls
